notes:
Quick summary: mid-market product analytics vendor, building an in-app AI assistant (support + search) and server-side reranker for personalized results. Team wants to start on Redwood Hosted API to move fast (trial tokens) then migrate to Dedicated once usage stabilizes. Primary blocker is data residency + regional routing (EU).

Key quotes / paraphrases: "We need EU data to never leave region for PII-derived vectors" — Head of Security. "Latency for search needs p99 < 120ms from EU customers; chat can tolerate 150–200ms if cost savings are significant" — CTO.

Technical points captured:
- POC plan: 2-week hosted POC (proof of concept) using eu-west-1 endpoint for semantic-search + reranking; followed by Dedicated sizing POC on reserved GPUs in eu-central-1.
- Early latency tests (dev): hosted eu-west p50 ~ 40ms, p99 ~ 180ms; routing to eu-central reduced p99 to ~110ms in preliminary tests. Multi-region fallback (eu-west primary, eu-central fallback) adds ~25–35ms on fallback.
- Throughput goal: 150 qps for search reranker during peak; chat concurrency lower (20–30).
- Cost sensitivity: high — wants to understand token/unit costs + effect of batching & KV cache. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching profiles).
- Security ask: SSO (SAML), SOC2 report, KMS encryption at rest, audit logs with 12+ month retention, and a clear EU data residency SLA (contract clause).

- 2026-01-15: Intro call (AE Liam O'Connor) — qualifies use case and budget band.
- 2026-02-03: Product demo (hosted flows) with SE (Priya Das). Demo link: ff_2026-02-18_8421.
- 2026-02-18: Hosted POC kickoff; sent test prompts & eval set for reranking.

Next tacticals / recommended steps:

- Run 48-hour latency POC with multi-region routing enabled (measure p50/p95/p99 and egress costs).
- Draft EU data residency contract addendum and sample auditors packet for legal team review (Elena to deliver).

Misc notes: development team will instrument a small eval harness to capture token-level cost and latency by region. They prefer minimal code changes to swap endpoints (routing via header + model alias). Procurement indicated potential 12–18 month commit if cost projections align.
